caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded clay pot with a wide body and a narrow, slightly flared opening at the top. The pot is positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The surface of the pot shows a smooth texture with subtle variations in color, primarily consisting of light browns, tans, and some faint grayish hues, giving it a natural, earthen appearance. The shading around the pot creates an impression of volume and three-dimensionality. There are no additional objects or significant decorative elements within the composition, and the artist’s signature, "Annie B. Johnston," appears at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Stoneware Flower Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
